integrity: A self-contained proof is provided; independent audit has not been performed. Exhaustive finite experiments corroborate but do not establish the infinite claim.
scientific_limitations: Exact for inclusion-minimal total domination on T_n=L(K_n), n>=3. Does not give all-set polynomial or unrestricted line graphs. General proof combines a forest/spider characterization and exponential enumeration. Complete prior-published equivalences remain an access/terminology priority risk.
title: Minimal total dominating sets of triangular graphs are forests of subdivided stars
